case.title: Question the KB does not answer (HIPAA BAA + obscure EHR)
case.subject: HIPAA BAA and MedTrakkr integration?
case.text:
Hello,

We're a small family practice in Ohio evaluating Slotwise. Before we can sign up, two questions:

1. Will Slotwise sign a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement with us?
2. Do you integrate with MedTrakkr EHR v4 so appointments sync into patient charts?

We need written answers for our compliance officer.

Best,
Robert Chen, MD
case.why: Nothing in the help center covers HIPAA BAAs or MedTrakkr. The draft must not invent a yes; it should go to review with a no_source or low-confidence flag.

output.reply:
Hello Dr. Chen,

Thank you for considering Slotwise. Because you need written answers for your compliance officer, I don't want to guess on either question, so I'm passing your email to our team to reply in writing.

1. HIPAA BAA: I can't confirm whether Slotwise signs a Business Associate Agreement. Our privacy team will answer this directly. For context, Slotwise data is stored in the EU, and our data processing agreement (DPA) is available in Settings → Data → Legal documents once you have an account.

2. MedTrakkr EHR v4: I have no information about a MedTrakkr integration. The only calendar integration I can confirm is two-way Google Calendar sync. I've included your question so the team can confirm the current status in writing.

You don't need to resend anything. We'll follow up by email.

Best regards,
Slotwise Support
